meta.title: Market Ledger — India
meta.subtitle: Indian Stock-Market Government Revenue Estimation Platform
meta.disclaimer: Quantitative financial estimates derived from official exchange BhavCopy, delivery records, and statutory schedules. Not actual Treasury receipts.

quality_report.official_disclaimer: Estimated statutory revenue calculated from official exchange BhavCopy, Gross Delivery, and Derivatives summaries using date-effective statutory tax rates. These are deterministic quantitative estimates and must not be construed as actual government Treasury receipts.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Purchase value of deliverable equity shares (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2004 Chapter VII Section 98 Item 1
tax_schedules.notes: 0.1% on purchase value of equity shares settled by delivery.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Sale value of deliverable equity shares (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2004 Chapter VII Section 98 Item 2
tax_schedules.notes: 0.1% on sale value of equity shares settled by delivery. Round-trip delivery STT is 0.2%.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Sale value of non-delivery / intraday equity shares (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2004 Chapter VII Section 98 Item 3
tax_schedules.notes: 0.025% on sell side only for non-delivery squared-off intraday transactions. Buy side is Nil.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Purchase value of units of business trust (InvITs/REITs)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2014 Section 98 Item 1
tax_schedules.notes: 0.1% on purchase of units of business trust settled by delivery.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Sale value of units of business trust (InvITs/REITs)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2014 Section 98 Item 2
tax_schedules.notes: 0.1% on sale of units of business trust settled by delivery.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Sale value of non-delivery intraday trust units
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2014 Section 98 Item 3
tax_schedules.notes: 0.025% on sell side of intraday trust units.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Sale value of units of equity-oriented mutual fund / ETF
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance Act 2023 Section 98 Item 4
tax_schedules.notes: 0.001% on sell side of equity ETF units.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Sale value of Rights Entitlement (RE) in demat form
tax_schedules.official_source: CBDT Notification S.O. 1221(E); SEBI Rights Entitlements Circular
tax_schedules.notes: 0.125% on sale side of tradable rights entitlements.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Not Applicable
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance Act 2008 (Abolition of STT on debt instruments)
tax_schedules.notes: Corporate debt securities
null: and SGBs are completely exempt from STT.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Price at which future is traded on sale side (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance Act 2023 Section 98 Item 4(a)
tax_schedules.notes: Historical rate prior to 1 Oct 2024: 0.0125% on sale side.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Price at which future is traded on sale side (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 Chapter VII Section 98 Item 4(a)
tax_schedules.notes: Statutory amendment effective 1 Oct 2024: increased from 0.0125% to 0.02% on sale side.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Price at which future is traded on sale side (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance Act 2023 Section 98 Item 4(a)
tax_schedules.notes: Historical rate prior to 1 Oct 2024: 0.0125% on sale side.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Price at which future is traded on sale side (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 Chapter VII Section 98 Item 4(a)
tax_schedules.notes: Statutory amendment effective 1 Oct 2024: increased from 0.0125% to 0.02% on sale side.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Option premium value on sale side (Traded Premium * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance Act 2023 Section 98 Item 4(b)
tax_schedules.notes: Historical rate prior to 1 Oct 2024: 0.0625% on premium value.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Option premium value on sale side (Traded Premium * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 Chapter VII Section 98 Item 4(b)
tax_schedules.notes: Statutory amendment effective 1 Oct 2024: increased from 0.0625% to 0.1% on option premium sale.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Option premium value on sale side (Traded Premium * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance Act 2023 Section 98 Item 4(b)
tax_schedules.notes: Historical rate prior to 1 Oct 2024: 0.0625% on premium value.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Option premium value on sale side (Traded Premium * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 Chapter VII Section 98 Item 4(b)
tax_schedules.notes: Statutory amendment effective 1 Oct 2024: increased from 0.0625% to 0.1% on option premium sale.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Settlement price / intrinsic value of exercised options (or physical delivery equity rate)
tax_schedules.official_source: Finance (No. 2) Act 2004 Section 98 Item 4(c); Circular NSE/CML/2019/11
tax_schedules.notes: 0.125% payable by purchaser on exercise. Physical settlement on stock options triggers 0.1% delivery rate on settlement value.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Deliverable purchase value of equity shares (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Item 27; Finance Act 2019
tax_schedules.notes: 0.015% (Rs 1500 per crore) on BUY side only. Remitted to state of investor residence.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Non-delivery intraday purchase value (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Item 27; Finance Act 2019
tax_schedules.notes: 0.003% (Rs 300 per crore) on BUY side only.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Deliverable purchase value of units of business trust (InvITs/REITs)
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Item 27
tax_schedules.notes: 0.015% on BUY side only.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Transfer value of corporate debentures / bonds
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Article 27
tax_schedules.notes: 0.0001% (Rs 10 per crore) on BUY side of corporate bonds.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Not Applicable
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Section 8A
tax_schedules.notes: Government securities and SGBs are completely exempt from stamp duty.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Futures contract buy value (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Item 27; Finance Act 2019
tax_schedules.notes: 0.002% (Rs 200 per crore) on BUY side only.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Futures contract buy value (Price * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Item 27; Finance Act 2019
tax_schedules.notes: 0.002% (Rs 200 per crore) on BUY side only.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Option premium buy value (Traded Premium * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Item 27; Finance Act 2019
tax_schedules.notes: 0.003% (Rs 300 per crore) on BUY side premium only.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Option premium buy value (Traded Premium * Quantity)
tax_schedules.official_source: Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Item 27; Finance Act 2019
tax_schedules.notes: 0.003% (Rs 300 per crore) on BUY side premium only.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Gross turnover value across all securities
tax_schedules.official_source: SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations 1992 Schedule V Part A
tax_schedules.notes: Rs 10 per crore (0.0001%) of turnover. Regulatory fee revenue for SEBI.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Gross futures contract traded turnover
tax_schedules.official_source: SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations 1992 Schedule V Part A
tax_schedules.notes: Rs 10 per crore (0.0001%) of futures turnover.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Traded options premium turnover
tax_schedules.official_source: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/MRD/MRD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2024/90
tax_schedules.notes: Rs 10 per crore (0.0001%) on premium turnover (revised from notional base to premium base).

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Taxable financial supply: Exchange Transaction Charges + SEBI Fees
tax_schedules.official_source: Central Goods and Services Tax Act 2017 Chapter V; Integrated GST Act
tax_schedules.notes: 18% GST applies strictly to taxable service charges (Exchange fees + SEBI fees). Explicitly NOT levied on market turnover.

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Hypothetical financial service: Estimated broker commissions
tax_schedules.official_source: Central Goods and Services Tax Act 2017; Brokerage GST Schedule
tax_schedules.notes: 18% GST on retail and institutional brokerages. Labelled as ESTIMATED ASSUMPTION (requires assuming average brokerage rate per trade).

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Gross cash market turnover
tax_schedules.official_source: NSE Circular NSE/CMP/64312 (Flat transaction charge structure)
tax_schedules.notes: Non-government exchange income. Rs 297 per crore (0.00297%).

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Gross futures contract turnover
tax_schedules.official_source: NSE Circular NSE/FAOP/64313
tax_schedules.notes: Non-government exchange income. Rs 173 per crore (0.00173%).

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Traded options premium turnover
tax_schedules.official_source: NSE Circular NSE/FAOP/64313
tax_schedules.notes: Non-government exchange income. Rs 3503 per crore (0.03503% on premium).

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Gross cash market turnover (Group A/B)
tax_schedules.official_source: BSE Notice 20240928-11
tax_schedules.notes: Non-government exchange income. Rs 300 per crore (0.003%).

tax_schedules.taxable_base: Traded options premium turnover
tax_schedules.official_source: BSE Notice 20240928-12
tax_schedules.notes: Non-government exchange income. Rs 3250 per crore (0.0325% on premium).
